description: This file contains unit tests for the HeaderValueValidators class in the Eclipse Ditto project, verifying validators for various header value types.

classes.name: HeaderValueValidatorsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HeaderValueValidators, testing the validation mechanisms for header values in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that HeaderValueValidators class is immutable.

methods.name: getIntValueValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Verifies that the Integer validator correctly validates int and Integer types.

methods.name: getLongValueValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Verifies that the Long validator correctly validates long and Long types.

methods.name: getBooleanValueValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Verifies that the Boolean validator correctly validates boolean and Boolean types.

methods.name: getJsonArrayValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Checks that the JsonArray validator correctly validates JsonArray objects.

methods.name: getEntityTagValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Checks that the EntityTag validator correctly validates EntityTag instances.

methods.name: getEntityTagMatcherValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Checks that the EntityTagMatcher validator correctly validates EntityTagMatcher instances.

methods.name: getEntityTagMatchersValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Checks that the EntityTagMatchers validator correctly validates EntityTagMatchers instances.

methods.name: getDittoDurationValidatorReturnsAppropriateValidator
methods.description: Verifies that the DittoDuration validator correctly validates DittoDuration instances.

methods.name: validateStringWithNoOpValidator
methods.description: Ensures that the no-op validator does not throw exceptions for any input.

methods.name: validatorChainIsCompletelyTraversedUntilResponsibleValidator
methods.description: Tests that a chain of validators traverses correctly and throws appropriate exceptions on invalid input.
